entry.title: Tyholttårnet
entry.note: Exact Q1935277 co-centered tower parts identify Tyholttårnet. The square base way474904229 sets the horizontal axes; native +X follows its northeast edge, +Z is southeast. The two circular part tags are inconsistent: the 8.3 m ring is tagged restaurant while the 17.4 m ring is tagged concrete shaft. Current Trym owner photographs and the historical society’s 7.2 m concrete diameter show those classifications cannot be used literally. This reconstruction uses 7.2 m shaft diameter and the mapped 17.4 m projected pod diameter, preserving raw tags here. Rotational pod and shaft have no distinct compass front; small equipment phases are representative. The separately mapped attached office wings are not duplicated. Ground contact for the tower base; the separately mapped attached office wings are excluded. The rotational tower silhouette has no unique directed phase, while the actual square base supplies the planar axes. Antenna equipment phases are representative. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
